name: 29135 · St Matthews, SC
findings: ZIP 29135 (St Matthews) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29135 (St Matthews) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
